code: d[(d.decade == 199) & (d.type == 'fiction')].nlargest(10, 'count').assign(nyt=lambda x: x.awards.str.extract(r'(Never charted[^\n]*|\d+ weeks as a New York Times Best Seller)')[0].str.replace(' as a New York Times Best Seller', '').str.replace('Never charted', 'never').str.replace(' when published', ' (when published)'), streak=lambda x: x.awards.str.extract(r'(\d+)(?:st|nd|rd|th)[ -]longest[ -]streak')[0]).set_index('title')[['nyt', 'streak']]
